# Area

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

A conference message area with access checks and read/search operations.

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#board-objects-400).

```{warning}
Message reads do not apply the interactive reader's access/privacy filtering. The PPE must enforce visibility; `Valid` alone is not an access check. See [message visibility](../../../new_ppl.md#who-may-see-a-message-is-the-programs-decision).
```

## AllowAliases

`Area.AllowAliases: BOOLEAN`

## Find

```PPL
Area.Find(MsgField field, STRING text, [LONG startMessage]) Msg
```

Instance function.

Finds the next message whose `To`, `From`, or `Subject` field contains the text. Optional `startAfter` continues after a message number.

## Read

```PPL

```

Instance function.

Reads an exact message number. A missing message returns an invalid `MSG`; inspect its `Valid` property.
